name: Yatsuka Itsuki
source:
Itsuki is the protagonist’s childhood friend and also a student council member. She appears to be a serious and dignified girl but she actually has a lot of daydreams and delusions about the protagonist, whom she cares about dearly. She also swaps between being tsuntsun and deredere. Her family lives in a dojo so she’s been trained in the martial arts ever since she was a little girl.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/20/previewstrawberry-nauts/]Liemyx's preview[/url]]
